nativeSupport: 3-degree equal-area mascons; grid cells are not independent

region.name: Iowa and surrounding Midwest — six complete inland mascons
region.selection: Union of complete mascon IDs intersecting seed box at native cell centers; fixed regional context, not a basin or field boundary

sourceMetadata.title: JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO MASCON RL06.3Mv04 CRI
sourceMetadata.geospatial_lat_resolution: 0.5 degree grid; however the native resolution of the data is 3-degree equal-area mascons
sourceMetadata.GIA_removed: ICE6G-D; Peltier, W. R., D. F. Argus, and R. Drummond (2018) Comment on the paper by Purcell et al. 2016 entitled An assessment of ICE-6G_C (VM5a) glacial isostatic adjustment model, J. Geophys. Res. Solid Earth, 122.
sourceMetadata.postprocess_3: Coastline Resolution Improvement (CRI) filter has been applied to separate land/ocean mass within mascons that span coastlines
sourceMetadata.user_note_1: The accelerometer on the GRACE-B spacecraft was turned off after August 2016.  After this date, the accelerometer on GRACE-A was used to derive the non-gravitational accelerations acting on GRACE-B using a transplant procedure.  This has led to a subsequent degradation in the quality of the gravity fields derived.  The uncertainties in this file have been scaled to accomodate this degradation.
sourceMetadata.user_note_2: The accelerometer on the GRACE-D spacecraft began performing sub-optimally after June 21, 2018.  After this date, the accelerometer on GRACE-C is used to derive the non-gravitational accelerations acting on GRACE-D using a transplant procedure.  The uncertainties in the file have been scaled to accomodate this degradation using the current best state of knowledge.

timePolicy: Nominal months reconstructed from complete provider month sequence excluding months_missing; exact source centers and inclusive bounds retained. Some intervals overlap or cross calendar boundaries. No calendar-day redistribution.
uncertaintyPolicy: Native 1-sigma mascon diagnostics. Regional correlationBoundMm=sum(weight*sigma): perfect-positive-correlation upper bound for represented random errors only, not a calibrated confidence interval. Full covariance and systematic/leakage errors unavailable; no independent-pixel or independent-month reduction.
limitations: Terrestrial storage includes soil water, snow, surface water and groundwater; no groundwater depletion inference.
CRI reduces coastal leakage; inland leakage and regularization effects remain. No gain factors applied to complete mascon support.
No trend estimate or significance claim; temporal dependence and irregular solution windows remain.
Seasonal ranges describe available 2005–2024 solutions, not uncertainty intervals or future projections.
Regional storage and SMAP moisture, IMERG/POWER precipitation and ECOSTRESS ET describe different stocks, fluxes and supports; shared models and processing prevent independent-validation claims.
